entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: Cephalid leader of the Mer Empire on Dominaria, exiled by her husband and later empress.

entities.name: Emperor Aboshan
entities.description: Cephalid emperor, Llawan's husband, killed by his use of the Mirari.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Former ambassador to the Cabal who opposed Llawan in civil war and was defeated.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Created dementia beasts for Laquatus; his death made them vanish.

entities.name: Olsham
entities.description: Llawan's court mage who helped seal the chasm.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Zombie assassin created by the Cabal to hunt Laquatus.

entities.name: Cabal
entities.description: Surface group that Llawan had help trap Laquatus.

entities.name: Otaria Chasm
entities.description: Part of the Aboshan Trench where Laquatus holed up and was sealed in.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Battle in which Aboshan was killed by his use of the Mirari.

entities.name: Riptide Project
entities.description: Joint project of surface and Mer mages that ran out of control when the reborn Slivers broke free.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures reborn by the project that slaughtered its mages and reached the mainland.

events.summary: Aboshan becomes suspicious of Llawan and exiles her to the southern court, making her a symbol of the oppressed.
events.quote: Aboshan became suspicious of his wife and had her exiled to the southern court

events.summary: Llawan offers refuge to persecuted races while Aboshan sends assassins.
events.quote: she was often targeted by Aboshan's assassins

events.summary: Aboshan is killed by his use of the Mirari and Llawan moves for the throne.
events.quote: the Emperor was killed by his use of the

events.summary: Llawan and Laquatus fight an open civil war, Laquatus holing up in the Otaria Chasm.
events.quote: The two fought an open civil war under the waves

events.summary: Laquatus uses Chainer's dementia beasts; Llawan leads her leviathan, and Chainer's death makes the beasts vanish.
events.quote: Llawan led her leviathan into battle

events.summary: Llawan and Olsham seal the chasm with a portal barrier, trapping Laquatus's forces; the chasm's value was a ruse.
Llawan has the chasm rebels massacred and the Cabal abandon Laquatus in Krosa, with Balthor sent to hunt him, ending his threat.
events.quote: This finally ended Laquatus's threat to the empire.

events.summary: The Riptide Project runs out of control as reborn Slivers kill its mages and reach the mainland.
events.quote: Llawan's fate after this is unknown.
